blocks.text: LOS ANGELES — A California appeals court on Tuesday upheld actor Danny Masterson’s convictions and long prison sentence for raping two women at his home in 2003. In an 89-page ruling, the three-judge panel unanimously found that the “That ’70s Show” actor had failed to demonstrate that the lower court made errors that would warrant granting him a new trial. The panel also rejected a petition filed by Masterson that claimed ineffective assistance of counsel. Masterson’s first trial ended with a deadlocked jury in 2022, but at his retrial the following year, he was convicted of raping two women. He was […]...
